setting.editor.tabSize.title: Tab size
setting.editor.tabSize.description: Number of columns a tab character occupies.
setting.editor.indentSize.title: Indent size
setting.editor.indentSize.description: Number of columns of one indentation level.
setting.editor.insertSpaces.title: Indent with spaces
setting.editor.insertSpaces.description: Pressing Tab inserts spaces instead of a tab character.
setting.editor.detectIndentation.title: Detect indentation
setting.editor.detectIndentation.descrip: Guesses the tab size and whether to indent with spaces or tabs from the opened file.
setting.editor.wordWrap.title: Word wrap
setting.editor.wordWrap.description: Wraps long lines at the window edge.
setting.editor.renderWhitespace.title: Show whitespace
setting.editor.fontFamily.title: Font family
setting.editor.fontFamily.description: Comma-separated list of font families, the first installed one is used.
setting.editor.fontSize.title: Font size
setting.editor.fallbackFontFamily.title: Fallback fonts
setting.editor.fallbackFontFamily.descri: Comma-separated fonts tried for characters the main font does not have.
setting.editor.renderLineEndings.title: Show line endings
setting.editor.renderLineEndings.descrip: Draws CR, LF or CRLF at the end of each line. The document is not changed.
setting.editor.lineNumbers.title: Line numbers
setting.editor.lineNumbers.description: Shows the column with line numbers.
setting.editor.highlightCurrentLine.desc: Colors the line that holds the caret.
setting.editor.links.title: Clickable links
setting.editor.rightMargin.title: Right margin column
setting.editor.rightMargin.description: Draws a vertical guide after this many columns. 0 turns it off.
setting.editor.minimap.title: Minimap
setting.editor.minimap.description: Shows a reduced picture of the text at the right edge; drag it to scroll.
setting.files.encoding.title: Default encoding
setting.files.encoding.description: Encoding used for new files and for files whose encoding cannot be detected.
setting.files.eol.title: End of line
setting.files.eol.description: Line ending for new files. Auto uses the platform default.
setting.files.trimTrailingWhitespace.des: Removes spaces and tabs at line ends when saving.
setting.files.insertFinalNewline.title: Insert final newline
setting.files.insertFinalNewline.descrip: Adds a line ending at the end of the file when saving.
setting.files.autoSave.title: Auto save
setting.files.autoSave.description: Saves changed files to their own path.
setting.workbench.keymapProfile.title: Keymap profile
setting.workbench.keymapProfile.descript: Id of the keymap profile layered over the default keys.
setting.workbench.uiLanguage.title: Interface language
setting.workbench.uiLanguage.description: Language of menus and messages. Auto follows the system.
cmd.lsp.start: Language Server: Start for This Document
cmd.format.applyEditorConfig: Apply EditorConfig Encoding and Line Endings...
cmd.file.convertEncodingBatch: Convert Encoding of Files in a Folder...
cmd.files.delete: Move to Recycle Bin or Trash
reason.fileSelected.false: Nothing is selected in the file panel
setting.files.relatedFileRules.title: Related file rules
setting.files.relatedFileRules.descripti: Pairs of file name endings that belong together, written as ending|ending and separated by semicolons, for example .vert|.frag;.scss|.css. They are tried before the built-in rules.
setting.editor.autoClosePairs.title: Paired characters
setting.editor.autoClosePairs.descriptio: Adds the closing character after a bracket or quote.
setting.editor.continueComments.title: Continue comments
setting.editor.continueComments.descript: Enter inside a comment starts the next line as a comment.
setting.workbench.theme.title: Theme
setting.workbench.theme.description: Light, dark or follow the system.
setting.files.journalDirectory.title: Journal folder
setting.files.journalDirectory.descripti: Where unsaved work is written continuously for crash recovery. Empty: the profile folder.
setting.files.journalFallbackDirectory.d: Used when the main journal folder cannot be written. Empty: the system temp folder.
setting.history.enabled.title: Keep local history
setting.history.enabled.description: Keeps a revision of a file at every save and at every change made outside the editor.
setting.history.storeSecretFiles.title: Keep history of secrets files
setting.history.storeSecretFiles.descrip: Files such as .env hold secret values. Off: no revisions of them are stored, because the values would lie on disk as plain text.
setting.history.maxRevisionsPerFile.desc: The oldest revisions beyond this number are deleted; pinned ones stay. 0: no limit.
setting.history.maxAgeDays.title: Keep revisions for (days)
setting.history.maxAgeDays.description: Older revisions are deleted; the newest and pinned ones stay. 0: no limit.
setting.history.maxMiBPerFile.title: History size per file (MiB)
setting.history.maxMiBPerFile.descriptio: The oldest revisions beyond this size are deleted; the newest and pinned ones stay. 0: no limit.
setting.history.maxTotalMiB.title: History size in total (MiB)
setting.history.maxTotalMiB.description: When exceeded, the oldest unpinned revisions are deleted first. Pinned ones stay even if the limit cannot be met. 0: no limit.
setting.files.largeFileThreshold.title: Large file threshold (MiB)
setting.files.largeFileThreshold.descrip: A file above this size opens in the paged mode, which edits the file in place without loading the whole text.
setting.search.regexTimeoutMs.title: Regular expression time limit (ms)
setting.search.regexTimeoutMs.descriptio: A pattern with backreferences, lookaround or atomic groups runs in the backtracking engine and is stopped after this time on one text. Other patterns run in the linear-time engine and are not limited.
setting.hex.wildcardMaxBytes.title: Longest wildcard * in hex search (bytes)
setting.hex.wildcardMaxBytes.description: N, the most bytes the wildcard * and every open repeat of a regular expression over bytes (.*, +, {n,}) may stand for in the hex search. 0 means N is not chosen yet: a search with * then asks for it. A range of your own can always be written as *{m,n}.
setting.tools.diffTool.title: External diff tool
setting.tools.diffTool.description: Path of a program that compares two files. Empty: Compare with Disk opens the built-in comparison.
setting.tools.diffArguments.title: Diff tool arguments
setting.tools.diffArguments.description: Argument template; {left} is the file on disk, {right} the content of the tab.
setting.editor.profile.title: Behaviour profile
setting.editor.profile.description: Keys and editing behaviour: the default set or the one that follows PSPad.
setting.editor.enhancedHomeEnd.title: Smart Home and End
setting.editor.enhancedHomeEnd.descripti: Home jumps between the first non-blank character and the line start, End between the last non-blank character and the line end.
setting.editor.backspaceUnindent.title: Backspace in indentation
setting.editor.backspaceUnindent.descrip: Backspace at the end of the indentation removes spaces back to the previous tab stop.
setting.editor.altDragMode.title: Alt+drag
setting.editor.altDragMode.description: What dragging with Alt held makes: one caret per row, or a block selection.
setting.editor.pairStyle.title: Pair rules
setting.editor.pairStyle.description: Rules for adding closing brackets and quotes: the default ones or the ones of PSPad.
setting.editor.smartKeys.renameTag.title: Rename paired tag
setting.editor.smartKeys.renameTag.descr: Editing the name of an HTML or XML tag changes the matching tag too.
setting.editor.smartKeys.closeTag.title: Complete closing tag
setting.editor.smartKeys.closeTag.descri: Typing </ after an open tag adds its name and the closing bracket.
Escape on paste into a string
Pasted quotes and backslashes are escaped inside a string literal.
setting.editor.smartKeys.jsonComma.title: Commas in JSON
setting.editor.smartKeys.jsonComma.descr: Enter at the end of a JSON value adds the missing comma when another value follows.
setting.editor.smartKeys.phpArrow.title: Arrow after a PHP variable
setting.editor.smartKeys.phpArrow.descri: Typing - right after a PHP variable adds ->.
A double click on a PHP variable selects its name without the dollar sign.
setting.editor.smartKeys.sqlEnd.title: Close BEGIN with END
setting.editor.smartKeys.sqlEnd.descript: Enter after BEGIN in SQL adds a matching END line.
cmd.hex.layout: Hex Layout: Bytes per Row, Grouping...
cmd.hex.minimap.mode: Hex: Map by Entropy or Kind of Byte
setting.files.binaryAsHex.title: Binary files in hex
setting.files.binaryAsHex.description: What happens when a file has a NUL byte in its first 8,000 bytes: ask with a bar, always open in hex, or never switch.
setting.editor.clipboardHistorySize.desc: How many copied texts the clipboard history keeps. It is kept in memory only and forgotten when the program closes.
setting.editor.dateTimeFormat.title: Date and time format
setting.editor.dateTimeFormat.descriptio: .NET custom format, for example yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm. Used by Insert Date and Time; month and day names follow the interface language.
setting.sql.dialect.title: Default SQL dialect
setting.sql.dialect.description: Dialect of SQL files that neither the file nor the folder sets. Folder: sql_dialect in .editorconfig.
setting.html.tidyPath.title: HTML Tidy program
setting.html.tidyPath.description: Full path of the HTML Tidy program. Empty: the editor looks next to the formatters plugin, in tools/tidy and in PATH.
setting.remote.versionCheck.title: Check of the server version
setting.remote.versionCheck.description: stat: size and modification time (the content is fetched only when they differ). content: always fetch the server content and compare it; slower, and it also notices a change within the same second and size.
cmd.tools.mcpServer: MCP Server: Switch On or Off...
cmd.tools.ideBridge: IDE Bridge /ide: Switch On or Off...
cmd.tools.shellMenuAdd: Add Textida to the Explorer Menu
setting.review.autoKeep.title: Keep changes from outside without review
setting.review.autoKeep.description: On: when another program changes the file of a tab without unsaved edits, the tab takes the new content at once and no review is offered. Off: the changes wait for your review.
setting.updates.checkOnStart.title: Check for updates at start
setting.updates.checkOnStart.description: Asks the update address for the newest version when Textida starts, and shows a bar when there is one. Off by default; nothing else is sent.
setting.advanced.scrollPastEnd.title: Scroll past the end of the text
setting.advanced.scrollPastEnd.descripti: Lets the last line scroll up to the top of the editor, leaving empty space below the text.
setting.advanced.cutCopyWholeLine.title: Cut and copy the whole line without a selection
setting.advanced.cutCopyWholeLine.descri: With nothing selected, Cut and Copy take the line of the caret including its line break.
setting.advanced.hideMouseWhileTyping.ti: Hide the mouse pointer while typing
setting.advanced.hideMouseWhileTyping.de: The mouse pointer disappears over the text while you type and returns when you move the mouse.
setting.advanced.linkNeedsCtrl.title: Open links only with Ctrl+click
setting.advanced.linkNeedsCtrl.descripti: On: a link opens with Ctrl+click. Off: a plain click opens it. Applies only when links are turned on.
setting.advanced.wrapIndent.title: Indent of wrapped lines (columns)
setting.advanced.wrapIndent.description: How many columns the continuation of a wrapped line is indented, on top of the indentation of the line itself. Applies with word wrap on.
setting.advanced.recentFilesCount.title: Recent files kept
setting.advanced.recentFilesCount.descri: How many recently opened files the list keeps. 0 keeps none. A lower number cuts the list the next time a file is opened.
setting.advanced.autosaveIntervalSeconds: How often a document with changes is written to its own file when Autosave is on.
